editorial.blurb: Hon Kee delivers authentic Chinese BBQ with showstopping Peking duck and tender roasted meats, perfect for group celebrations at their spacious tables.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Peking duck—reviewers rave about the crispy duck and phenomenal bao buns. Come Friday night when the restaurant shines with its beautiful chandeliers and lazy susan tables, and arrive as a group to fully experience the communal dining setup.
signatureDishes: BBQ Duck & Chicken with Rice & Broccoli
